therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibition combined with DNA synthesis inhibition and DNA crosslinking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and direct cytotoxic effects on cancer cells

results.dose_information: Sunitinib 25mg orally daily for 2 weeks followed by 1 week rest; Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m² and Cisplatin 35 mg/m² IV on days 1 and 8

context.duration: Neoadjuvant treatment followed by radical cystectomy, 2-year follow-up
